description: This file defines a React-like component for a top navigation bar in a web app, using Qwik framework. It includes UI elements such as app title, search input, and action buttons, along with associated logic for handling user interactions.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Creates a Qwik component that manages the TopBar UI, handling props for adding notes and searching.

methods.name: submitSearch$
methods.description: Wraps the search submission logic, trimming the query and invoking the search callback if provided.
